label: Blind sample 033: Hansen forest loss 2023, tile 60N_100E

verdict.headline: Real change
verdict.statement: Greenness (NDVI) fell by 0.20 relative to the control trajectory in the 18 months after 1 Jan 2023 (90% interval −0.19 to −0.14). Of 60 untouched cells given the same test, 4 showed a divergence this large (placebo p = 0.08).

evidence.sentence: Optical shows the change (greenness (NDVI) fell by 0.20); radar has too few observations to weigh in.

notes: kept cells whose dominant land cover is tree cover like the area
kept cells within 150 m of the area's elevation (521 m)
ranked by pre-event similarity; kept the best 80
